title: Best Speech Recognition Experts (2026): Voice-to-Text Solutions
description: How to hire a speech recognition expert to turn audio into text in apps, call centers or workflows: accuracy, languages, privacy, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Speech recognition experts build systems that convert spoken audio into text: transcribing calls and meetings, adding voice commands to apps, captioning videos or analyzing customer conversations. Good systems are tested on your real audio, with your accents, background noise and vocabulary. Projects go wrong when accuracy is judged on clean samples, specialized terms are misheard, or recordings of people are handled without consent. This guide helps you get voice-to-text that works in practice.
